name: get_customer_appointments
description: List a customer's appointments (all statuses) with service, date, start time, slot and technician.

name: get_appointment
description: Read one appointment by ID: customer, status, service, date, start time, slot and technician.

name: check_day_availability
description: List open slots on one date for one service type, offered by technicians who have the service's skill and cover the given region.

service.description: Service type code, as shown on the appointment, e.g. hvac_repair.

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Move an appointment to another slot. Fails with a conflict if the slot is already booked.

name: defer_goal
description: Stop without changing anything and hand the request back, with a short reason.
